verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents running on your own machine as a self-hosted single binary, which lets users decide where their data physically lives. It also offers exporting backups to the user's own cloud account. However, nothing in the pack documents choosing a region or data-residency setting for ClickHouse Cloud services. missing for 10: documented ClickHouse Cloud region selection, data-residency guarantees or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run ClickHouse on your own machine to build, test, and experiment.
Export backups to your own cloud account
